pick.headline: Soviet troops seize buildings in Vilnius
pick.summary: On 11 January 1991 Soviet troops seized the press building and other sites in Vilnius as Moscow moved against Lithuania's independence government.
pick.significance: The seizures were the prelude to the bloody storming of the Vilnius television tower two days later, which ended hopes that Gorbachev would let the Baltic republics go peacefully.

alternates.headline: Algeria's President Chadli resigns under army pressure
alternates.summary: On 11 January 1992 Algerian President Chadli Bendjedid resigned; the army then cancelled the second round of elections the Islamic Salvation Front was poised to win.
alternates.significance: The military's intervention plunged Algeria into a decade of civil war that killed well over 100,000 people.
